(25)༄༅/ /khro phu bka' brgyud las byung ba'i phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa'i khrid yig

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (25)༄༅// khro phu bka' brgyud las byung ba'i phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa'i khrid yig

bzhugs so// (26)༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma na ro pa'i gdams ngag snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa/ phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa 'di la gnyis te/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dang*/ gdams pa dngos po// dang po ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ sdud pa pos bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po la bshad/ des rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tai lo pa la bshad/ des rje btsun nā ro pa la bshad/ des rje btsun lho grag pa la/ des rje btsun mi la ras pa la/ des rje sgam po pa la/ des rje phag mo gru pa la/ des rgyal tshab rin po che la/ des kun ldan ras pa la/ des gnubs khro phu lo chen gyi mtshan tshul khrims shes rab la'o// gnyis pa gdams pa dngos ni/ phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa zer yang*/ tshig 'bru bzhi ste sems kyi gzhi rtsa bcad pa dang*/ sems kyi bzhag thabs bstan pa dang*/ sems kyi gol sa bcad pa dang*/ sems kyi lam khyer bstan pa dang bzhi'o// dang po ni/ sems nyid 'di ga nas byung*/ bar du gang na gnas/ tha (27)ma gang du 'gro brtags pas/ dang po byung sa med de/ rgyu dang rkyen las ma byung bas/ ye stong rtsa bral gcig tu 'dug /bar du gnas pa med de/ dbyibs dang kha dog tu ma grub pas/ 'gyu ba stong rgyu/ snang ba stong snang du 'dug tha mar 'gro sa med de/ 'dir song rjes med pas 'gyu ba rang grol rang sangs zhig 'dug /des na sems nyid 'di dang po rgyu sa ma bskyed pas/ tha ma rkyen gyis mi 'jig /dus glo bur du ma byung bas gang stongs 'phel 'grib med/ snang srid kun la khyab pas phyogs ris su ma chad/ dngos po dang mtshan mar ma grub pas/ 'dis mtshan du med pa cis kyang ma 'gag /cir yang ma grub pas yod med rtag chad kyi mtha' las 'das/ dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pas skye shi la gsal 'grib med/ rang bzhin ye nas dag pas 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa yin te/

sems nyid ye nas sangs rgyas yin gsungs/ gnyis pa bzhag thabs bstan pa ni/ de la rtag tu blo mi gnas par bya ba'i (28)thabs la drug ste/ khyung chen nam mkha' la lding ba bzhin du/ ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang la rtsol sgrub med par bzhag /rgya mtsho rlabs dang bral ba bzhin du sems g.yo 'gul med par bzhag /nyi ma sprin dang bral ba bzhin du/ kun gsal mdangs dang ldan par bzhag /bu chung lha khang blta ba bzhin du/ gsal cha ma 'gags la 'dzin cha med par bzhag /chu'i rba rlabs bzhin du/ byung tshor thams cad shes par byas la bzhag nam mkha' la bya 'phur ba bzhin du/ rig pa rjes med du bzhag go /gsum pa sems kyi gol sa gcod pa la gsum ste/ yar sangs rgyas la re na gol bas/ sems las ma gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas gcig logs na med par blo thag bcad/ mar 'khor ba la dgos na gol bas/ rang rtog 'khrul pa ma gtogs pa'i sems can logs na med par blo thag bcad/ bar gyi snang ba la zhen na gol bas/ cir snang thams cad rmi lam sgyu mar blo thag bcad/ nang gi nyams la zhen na gol bas/ phyag rgya chen po yid la byar med par kho thag bcad/ las rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod na gol bas/ rnam rtog ma zad bar du las rgyu 'bras kyis mi bslu bar kho thag bcad do// bzhi pa sems kyi lam khyer bstan pa ni/ spyod pa rgyun gyi rnal 'byor drug ste/ nyin mo snang ba rgyas gdab pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ nang nub 'dod yon grogs su khyer ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ srod la dbang po gzhi la bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ nam gung shes bya bum par gzhug pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ tho rangs rig pa gsal cha gdab pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ 'chi khar ye shes zang thal du gtong ba'i rnal 'byor ro// nyin mo snang ba rgyas gdab pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ 'di ltar gyi snang ba thams cad sems 'khrul par rgyas (29)gdab/ 'khrul pa rang bzhin med pas rmi lam sgyu mar rgyas gdab/ sgyu ma la ngos bzung med pas stong par rgyas gdab bo// nang nub 'dod yon grogs su khyer ba'i rnal 'byor ni/

rang ci za ci 'thung thams cad stong pa la stong par rol/ chos nyid la chos nyid thim pa'i tshul gyis longs spyod/ bla ma yi dam gyi lha la mchod pa'i bsam pas rol zhing longs spyad/ srod la dbang po bzhi la bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ nyin mo'i rnam rtog 'khrul pa'i dran pa gang shar la cer cer blta'o// nam gung shes bya bum par gzhug pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ snying ga dkyil du bla ma bsgom/ rtog pa'i gzhi chos nyid kyi ngang du bsdu'o/ nyin mo spyi gtsug tu bsgoms la de la shes pa gtad nas gnyid log pas 'od gsal du 'char ro// tho rangs rig pa gsal gdab pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ chos spyi dang rang gi sems nyid la gzhig 'grel btang zhing*/ khyad par du bla ma'i man ngag zab mos rig pa nyams kyi gsal gdab bo// 'chi khar ye shes zang thal du btang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ rnal 'byor pa 'chi kha'i tshe/ rnal 'byor pas dngos po'i chos thams cad kyi chags zhen rbad kyis bcad la/ don la sems la skye 'chi med pa/ phyag rgya chen po la bsgom rgyu med par kho thag bcad do// ma yengs par bzhag pas sems zang thal du song nas bar do med par sangs rgya'o// phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa rdzogs so// zhes khro phu lo tsā ba chen po gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyi gsung rab man ngag brgya rtsa las byung ba'o/// /(30)
